title: State the claim-id lexicographic tie-break rule in Gherkin prose
description:
SD nit #2 on PR #278: claim-id tie-break is shown in scenarios but the rule is not stated in feature prose.

The deterministic collision rule should be explicit in the Feature/Background text so implementers do not infer lexicographic order from examples alone.
right_now_summary: The feature prose still needs to state the lexicographic claim-id tie-break rule.
